title: How to Track Your Order
content: To track your order log into your account and navigate to My Orders. Select your order to view carrier tracking number shipment status and parcel delivery updates.

title: Track Your Order and Package Status
content: To track your order and package status log into your account or enter your tracking number to view real-time shipment status parcel tracking updates and estimated delivery.

title: Standard Return and Refund Policy
content: Items can be returned within 30 days of receipt if unused and in original packaging. Print a return label from the returns portal. Once returned refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Returning Damaged or Defective Items
content: If your item arrived damaged defective or broken please submit a replacement or return request within 7 days of delivery. Upload photos of the damaged merchandise and packaging for a free replacement or refund.

title: Refund Processing Times and Methods
content: Approved refunds are credited back to the original payment method used during purchase. Credit and debit card refunds take 3 to 5 business days depending on your bank. Store credits and wallet refunds are available immediately.

title: Accepted Payment Methods and Billing Inquiries
content: We accept major credit cards including Visa MasterCard and American Express as well as PayPal and Apple Pay. Your card is billed immediately when placing the order. For billing disputes or duplicate charges contact support.

title: Order Cancellation and Modification Guidelines
content: You can cancel or modify an order within 30 minutes of purchase from your Order History by clicking Cancel Order. Once an order enters processing or dispatch it cannot be canceled and must be returned after delivery.

title: Shipping Rates Delivery Speeds and Carriers
content: We offer standard shipping in 3 to 5 business days expedited shipping in 2 business days and priority overnight delivery. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on package weight and destination. Free standard shipping applies to orders over 50 dollars.

title: Resetting Account Password and Login Help
content: If you forgot your password or cannot sign in click Forgot Password on the login page. Enter your registered email address to receive a password reset link. Passwords must be at least 8 characters long with numbers and special symbols.

title: Updating Shipping Address and Account Profile
content: To update your delivery address or contact details log into your account settings and update your address book. Address updates for placed orders can only be made before the order status updates to shipped.

title: International Shipping and Customs Duties
content: We ship internationally to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping typically takes 7 to 14 business days. Destination customs duties import taxes and clearing fees are the responsibility of the recipient.

title: Customer Return Policy and Refund Guidelines
content: Customers can return items within 30 days of purchase in unused condition and original packaging. Print a prepaid return label from the returns portal. Approved refunds are credited back to your payment method within 5 to 7 days.
